fields.statement: QA with a scratch build: rhiza workflow describe shows retry_from (prefixed plan/interview when plan is included by a workflow step; built-in plan and plan-milestone review-loop steps show retry_from -> interview); rhiza workflow check refuses a retry_from naming no step, done/failed, or itself, naming step and key

QA with a scratch build: a run failing at a step with retry_from = prep was retried by rhiza run resume --retry at prep (dry run named prep), the retried journal entry recorded failed: check, prep's max_visits = 1 counted afresh, and the run succeeded

QA with a scratch build and fake rex/claude: after a retry restarting an agent step, its visit-2 brief.md held a Previous attempt section (failed step, outcome, failing command, output tail, latest round's findings); the pre-retry and never-retried briefs had none. Plan review findings show without a severity (minor finding)

QA with a scratch build: rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.daemon.watchdog.failedRetries and rhiza.project.watchdog.failedRetries (default 1); daemon set accepts 0 and 3 and refuses -1, abc, 1.5 and empty; inbox keeps a failed run while no daemon runs; go test ./internal/api -run 'Watchdog|Inbox' and TestScripts/watchdog-policy pass
